# ADR 0005: Exclude protected attributes

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Credit-card default risk scorecard API

## Context

The dataset includes sex and marital status; using them is discriminatory and often illegal.

## Decision

Never use sex or marital status as inputs; report outcomes by grade with and without age as a fairness check.

## Consequences

Defensible model; slightly lower raw separation is possible.

## Alternatives considered

Using all columns 'because they predict'.
